batting.name: MV Boucher
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b CRD Fernando

batting.name: SP Goswami
batting.dismissal: c A Nehra b CRD Fernando

batting.name: Misbah-ul-Haq
batting.dismissal: c SR Tendulkar b CRD Fernando

batting.name: CL White
batting.dismissal: c CRD Fernando b DR Smith

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c YV Takawale b A Nehra

batting.name: R Vinay Kumar
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b CRD Fernando

batting.name: ST Jayasuriya
batting.dismissal: c B Akhil b DW Steyn

balls.text: Praveen's run out! He backs away and tries to hit a short of a length ball down the ground, he misses and then sets off for the bye a bit too late, Takawale lobs the ball to Fernando who gets back to his stumps calmly and breaks the stumps with Praveen well short
he's caught this time! Vinay tries to clear long-on once again but this time he didn't get under the ball, he hits it straight to Uthappa at long on
that's much better! Vinay Kumar backs away and gets under a full ball which angles into him and lofts Fernando into the second tier at long-on
what is Vinay trying? He backs away towards leg this time and tries to play a reverse swat to a good length ball from Fernando that passes over the top of his stumps
short of a length angling into the right-hander, Praveen flicks off his hips to deep backward square leg
Praveen makes lots of room and swings hard but gets beaten by Fernando's pace

dropped! Vinay moves outside the line of off stump and tries to scoop a full ball over short fine leg, he gets bat on it and hits it in the air, Pollock runs back and gets into a good position but can't hold on
and Bowden is at it again! Kulkarni sprays another one wide outside off
Vinay Kumar swings wildly at a good length ball outside off and misses completely, he had come down the track and lost his balance
that's another wide ball outside off stump, Bowden shows off his wares for the second time in a row
Vinay moves across his stumps and tries to get into position to play the Misbah paddle over short fine leg, Kulkarni counters by bowling wide outside off stump
a slower ball wide outside off stump, Praveen reaches out for it and mis-times the shot to cover
this time the length isn't that short but Praveen tries to pull anyway, he gets beaten
that's too short and Praveen gets on to the front foot and pulls the ball hard into the gap between deep midwicket and long-on, that's timed well by Praveen
Vinay Kumar was trying to pull towards deep midwicket but ends up hitting it towards long-on
Smith ends his spell with another one in the block hole, dug out behind square on the leg side
lovely footwork, Vinay Kumar backs away towards leg to make room and lofts a length delivery inside out into the gap between long off and deep cover
a bit short from Smith, Praveen pulls to Fernando at deep midwicket
the quicker yorker just outside off stump, Praveen swings hard, trying to hit down the ground, but gets beaten
flicked off the pads to Tendulkar at midwicket for a single
pushed towards Jayasuriya at cover
he's spoilt his figures a little bit by firing a wide down leg side, the keeper has no chance and the ball runs to the boudnary for five wides
Fernando ends the over with a bouncer, the batsman ducks under it
that's hit with tremendous power, Vinay Kumar backs away to make room and clobbers a full ball towards Nehra at mid-off who barely had time to get down before the ball reached him
played off the back foot towards point

flicked firmly off his pads towards long leg where Pollock runs to his left and slides, he does well to stop the ball with his boot, did he touch the boundary as his foot touched the ball? It's a close call, the third umpire says it's clean
that's a sharp bouncer, the ball rises quickly on Vinay Kumar who tries to hook off the back foot, he gets a big top edge which flies over Takawale for four
full toss on middle stump, pushed off the front foot towards midwicket
bowled wide down leg side, Billy Bowden signals wide in his unique exaggerated way
slower ball outside off stump, driven off the front foot towards point, another fabulous over from Smith
full ball on middle stump, pushed back towards the bowler of the front foot

Smith's got another one! He pitches the ball around off stump and slants it into the right-hander, Akhil moves across his stump, gets down on one knee and tries to play a cheeky sweep, he misses and gets hit in front of middle, that's plumb and AV Jayaprakash raises the finger in a flash
pushed off the back foot towards midwicket for a single
good length delivery angles into the right-hander from outside off, Praveen defends on the back foot

bowled him! Smith pitches on a good length on off stump and angles it into middle, Dravid stays in his crease, makes room, and tries to steer the ball from his stumps to third man, he misses completely and Smith hits
Dravid pushes the ball towards cover for a single
Nehra bangs in another short one which hurries on to Akhil who tries to pull, he's late on the shot and the ball lobs off the top edge safely towards short midwicket
played to point off the back foot
Nehra gives him a half-volley outside off stump, Akhil strides forward and drives the ball firmly through covers for four, lovely timing and placement, terrific shot to get off the mark

he's gone first ball! Nehra delivers an outstanding ball, he pitches it short of a length and gets it to rise sharply into Kohli who tries to run the ball down to third man, the ball gets far too big on him and he is cramped for room as well, Takawale takes the edge comfortably
a good length delivery angles into Dravid who stays in his crease and runs the ball to third man
Dravid opens the face and runs the ball towards third man for one, only one rune off the over and a wicket as well, Smith's done splendidly
Dravid moves on to the front foot and drives firmly to covers where Jayasuriya makes a sharp stop

caught! It's that man Fernando again! White tries to loft a length ball over deep midwicket, he doesn't get under it and therefore can't get the necessary elevation to clear the boundary, he hits it in the air to deep midwicket where Fernando runs in and holds a low catch, White had played three dot balls and the pressure told on him
Smith pitches on a good length around off and angles the ball into the right-hander, cramping White for room, he pushes the ball on the back foot towards the off side, three dots in a row, priceless
defended back to the bowler once again, tight line and length from smith, taking the pace off the ball
slow and low full toss from Smith outside off stump, White mis-times the attempted hit on the off side back to the bowler
short again but Kulkarni gets away with it, White pulls the ball hard off the front foot but finds the fielder at deep square leg
played towards backward point for one more
too short once again and White pulls the ball powerfully over midwicket for four more, massive over for Bangalore

White's hit this with enough power to clear the MCG! Kulkarni bowls a length ball outside off stump, White makes room and swings his bat hard to loft the ball straight over the bowler's head, that went on to the top of the second tier

too short from Kulkarni, White makes room and pulls the ball high and hard towards deep midwicket, he's not got enough power in the shot for the ball to clear the boundary, the ball bounces just inside the rope
Dravid waits on the back foot and cuts a short of a length ball through point
White backs away to make room and swats Kulkarni from a good length through square leg
nudged off the back foot towards the off side for a single
too short on middle and leg, White leans forward and flicks the ball off his pads past the fielder at short fine leg for the first boundary in 32 balls
Dravid waits in his crease and cuts the ball to third man
full length outside off stump, Dravid leans on to the front foot and drives to deep point, they run the second after some hesitation to bring up the 50
pushed off the front foot towards the off side from one more
played behind square on the off side, a direct hit from Pandey ricochets off the stumps and the batsmen run an overthrow
Kulkarni pitches short of a length and seams the ball away from the right-hander, Dravid tries to cut off the back foot but gets beaten
cut towards point where Manish Pandey fields to prevent the single
short of a length outside off, White moves back and plays a firm square drive to deep point
White backs away towards leg and Kulkarni sprays it wide outside off, that's a wide
Kulkarni appeals for lbw but Dravid had got a big inside edge on to pad as he tried to defend on the front foot, Kulkarni got the ball to nip into the right-hander
White gets off the mark by moving forward and punching a good length ball from outside off stump through cover
short of a length outside off, Dravid waits in his crease and steers the ball to third man where Fernando fields
White tries to drive on the off side but mis-times it to mid-on, spectacular over from Fernando, he has figures of 3 for 3 off two overs
good length from Fernando, he's hitting the pitch hard and angling it into the right-hander, White defends on the front foot
Fernando tests White with a bouncer and he ducks under it
a short of a length delivery bounces sharply on White who stays rooted to his crease and tries to play a tentative cut, he gets beaten
fuller length from Fernando, driven to midwicket

Fernando picks up his third! Goswami tries to loft a good length delivery down the ground, he gets the direction right but not the distance, the ball goes in the air between mid-on and mid-off, Uthappa goes for the catch from mid-off and so does Nehra from mid-on, there's a collision between the two but Nehra gets to the ball before Uthappa and holds the catch, well taken
fuller length on off stump, Dravid defends on the front foot towards the off side, Pollock runs across to field
another slow bouncer from Pollock, Goswami does well to hook it along the ground to long leg
Goswami backs away and tries to pull towards midwicket, the length is too good from Pollock and he gets beaten, the ball passes over the stumps
good length delivery angling into off stump, Dravid moves across his stumps and defends

Pollock pitches on a good length outside off and seams the ball into the right-hander, Dravid stays in his crease and opens the face, the ball hits the outside edge but bounces well short of first slip
pushed off the front foot towards cover for a single

caught! Misbah's failed on his birthday! Fernando pitches the ball short of a length and seams it away from the right-hander, Misbah stays on the back foot and pokes feebly at the ball, he gets an outside edge that goes to first slip where Tendulkar takes a comfortable catch at stomach height
dropped, Goswami tries to drive on the up through cover, he gets a thick outside edge to a ball that seams away from him, Takawale dives to his left, gets both hands to the ball but can't hold on
pushed towards short cover

caught by the local boy! Boucher tries to pull Fernando, the length is short but the ball stops on Boucher who plays the shot too early and mis-hits it high in the air to Uthappa who holds a simple catch between midwicket and mid-on
Bocuher backs away towards leg to make room, Fernando bowls it full outside off, Boucher reaches out and hits the ball on the leg side
played down to third man for a single
Goswami gets pinned on the back foot by Pollock's length, he drops the ball with soft hands on the off side and responds to Boucher's call
Pollock delivers a slow bouncer outside off stump, Boucher gets into position to play the pull too early, he does well to wait for the ball and hit it into the gap at midwicket
good length once again on off stump, Boucher moves back and defends
Boucher's taking Mumbai on! He steps down the track to a good length ball and swings Pollock hard towards the long leg boundary
better from Goswami, he moves forward and plays the fuller ball to third man with an open face of the bat
Goswami clears his front foot out of the way and tries to slog a good length ball that seams across the left-hander down the ground, that's a rash shot and he gets beaten

too short from Nehra, Boucher gets into position early, waits for the ball to reach him and hammers the ball through midwicket with a front-foot pull, he cleared the infield with ease and the ball screamed to the boundary
fuller length wide outside off stump, Boucher tees off and tries to smash the ball down the ground, he misses and Nehra gives him a smile

fantastic shot! Boucher stands in his crease, waits for the ball to angle across him and punches into the gap between midwicket and mid-on, superb use of the bottom hand and it was struck with enough power to beat the outfield
Boucher moves across his stumps and tries to slog a good length ball from outside off over midwicket, Nehra seams the ball back into the right-hander and beats the bat
good length delivery angling across the right-hander, Boucher defends on the back foot towards the bowler
Goswami moves deep in his crease and opens the face once again for a single to backward point
Goswami strides forward and opens the face to guide a delivery that slants across him past point and towards third man
Boucher moves forward and across an nudges a good length ball towards mid-on, Boucher calls and Goswami responds, nimble running

Pollock appeals confidently for lbw, he pitches the ball on a good length and nips the ball back into Boucher who moves back in his crease and tries to flick, he gets hit on the pad but the ball was going down leg
Goswami jumps back and pushes a ball off his hips towards square leg
Pollock bowls a shorter length and slants the ball across the left-hander, Goswami fends and gets beaten, he's not at ease against the shorter ball, he likes the length fuller
smashed! Goswami plants his front foot forward and lofts Pollock through the line back over his head for four, the heavy outfield didn't stop that
Nehra gets the ball to jag back into Boucher after slanting across the right-hander , Boucher tries to defend off the back foot and gets cut in half
Goswami leans forward to a fuller ball and pushes off his pads towards mid-on, he scurries through for the single
short of a length from Nehra outside off, Goswami tries to cut but gets beaten
Goswami leans into the line of the ball and opens the face to punch the ball through cover point, he's timed it will but the outfield is so slow that it allows Smith to slide and save the boundary
Nehra pitches short of a length and seams the ball away from the left-hander after angling into him, Goswami tries to steer to third man but misses

too full outside off stump with a hint of swing away from the left-hander, Goswami strides forward and drives fluently through cover, the fielder dives and takes some pace off the ball, the outfield is on the slower side
this time he opens the face and steers the ball towards third man
Pollock hits a good length and seams the ball across Goswami who stays in his crease and opens the face to play the ball to point
Goswami moves across and nudges a good length delivery off his pads towards midwicket

shot! But the outfield is slow so the ball won't reach the boundary, Boucher walks across his stumps to a good length ball and flicks it off his hips through square leg, Nehra runs across from fine leg to field
Goswami gets squared up by one that pitches around off stump and seams across the left-hander, Goswami gets an outside edge to third man
Pollock pitches on a good length on off and middle, the ball keeps low as well, Boucher waits in his crease and pushes the ball towards the leg side and calls for the quick single
another sweep - that vertical sweep from the little master and it's all over. The teams shakes hands as they walk back to the pavilion.
from round the stumps and Tendulkar sweeps fine to the boundary
short delivery and pulled to square leg region.
slower, fuller and Uthappa eases it to mid-on and rushes across for a quick single
short of length, outside off, cut to right of the diving white at point
Uthappa must have faced Akhil lots of time in the Karnataka nets. He leans forward to whip a length delivery to left of deep midwicket, wants a second, Tendulkar says you remain on strike.
similar line and this time Tendulkar twists his body and wrists it to fine leg
cuts it back into Tendulkar who tries to work it to square leg, misses and it runs off the pad to the off side
leans forward, towards the line of a length delivery and places it to left of mid-off
fullish, on the middle stump line, keeps a tad low - at least that's the impression Uthappa gives as he crouches slightly- and pushes it to mid-on
Nice. Easy. No risks. On a length, outside off stump, Uthappa opens his bat face and steers it to third man boundary.
just outside off and forced to right of point where White makes a neat diving stop
hurls across a bouncer but it's too high and Goswami gathers. AV Jayaprakash, standing in his last game - he is retiring after tonight- signals it a wide
outside off stump line and Tendulkar lets it go through to the 'keeper
lifting delivery outside off, SRT goes back and across, watches it jump up and lets it fly past him
short of length, cutting in and Robin gets a inside edge to a waft and it rolls over to square leg
What a shot! Awesome strike. Not all that short, climbing outside off, he went back and across and punched it beautifully over backward point. He has been taking lessons from Jayasuriya
shout for lbw but hit too hight. It cut in off a length, angling in to middle and leg, Robin tries to dab it to the onside , misses
short of length, outside off stump, dabbed to third man
on a length, leans forward to push to the off side
short of length and RObin stands tall to fist it past mid-off. Good punchy stroke there
length delivery just outside off stump and Tendulkar eases it to long-on
short of length, coming in Tendulkar tries to dab it off the pads, misses and it goes to the leg side and Vinay rushes across to make a tumbling stop
Another screamer. Uthappa hops but manages to sway away in time. Dropped his wrists as well to get the bat out of the way. Well adjusted in the end but you have to say Steyn is smelling blood here
Snorter. Where was Uthappa going? He hopped to a shortish delivery but he only jumped into trouble. Takes his eyes off but manages to get his bat out of line but is hit on the body.
And he is gone now. Short of length and Jayasuriya goes for his favourite short-arm jab but miscues it and sends a dolly to Akhil at midwicket. And he gets a thunderous applause from the crowd.
defended back to the bowler
Tendulkar cuts the ball to point for a single
Tendulkar charges down the track and lofts the ball over cover for a six, Mumbai are finishing this in a hurry
Jayasuriya drives a flatter ball  to long off for a single
paddled towards fine leg for a single
a full toss pushed towards long off
Jayasuriya hits his 31st six! It's full on the pads and Jayasuriya swings it over deep midwicket to reach his fifty
defended solidly off the front foot towards cover
Tendulkar makes room by moving towards leg and tries to blast the ball down the ground, the thick outside edge flies quickly to the third man boundary
a fraction short from Akhil and Jayasuriya mis-times the pull in the air but it falls safely at deep midwicket
short of a length outside off stump, Tendulkar punches off the back foot through cover for one more
Akhil pitches on leg stump and Jayasuriya moves across his stumps and pulls towards fine leg
Tendulkar moves forward and pushes the ball towards third man for a single
this time he gets inside the line and plays the ball firmly down to fine leg for four, eleven runs off the over
that's a bit short outside off stump, that's all Jayasuriya needs, he backs away to create room and lofts the ball over extra cover for four
Kumble bowls a quicker ball on middle and leg, Tendulkar moves across and flicks towards square leg
Jayasuriya moves back and across and flicks a flat ball off his pads through square leg
bowled flat on middle stump, pushed off the front foot towards point for a single
Tendulkar takes a step down the track and pushes a flat ball to short midwicket
he creates room again and tries to hit the ball over the off side, Vinay Kumar angles the ball into the left-hander and beats the bat
Jayasuriya backs away to create room and tries to hit inside out over cover, he gets beaten this time
is that 31? Not quite. Jayasuriya latches on to another short ball and pulls it flat towards deep midwicket, the ball bounces inches inside the boundary
that's his 30th! Jayasuriya moves forward and across his stumps and picks up a full length ball off his pads and flicks it hard and flat over the long leg boundary
that's too short and the length allows Jayasuriya to pull the ball off the front foot over deep midwicket for his 29th six of the tournament
a good length delivery angles into the left-hander, Jayasuriya defends on the off side
tight line and length on middle stump, Jayasuriya moves back and across and nudges towards midwicket
Jayasuriya defends back to the bowler
Tendulkar moves outside the line of off stump and tries to play the paddle sweep, he misses and gets hit on the pad
tight line and length around off stump, Jayasuriya cuts off the back foot for one more
defended on the front foot towards point
a full ball swings away from Tendulkar who reaches out for it wide outside off and tries to drive on the off side, he misses and Goswami misses as well
Tendulkar tries to play the paddle sweep from outside off but doesn't make proper contact
pitches on a good length and angles into Tendulkar, the ball stops on him a touch and he pushes off the front foot towards mid-on for a single
Jayasuriya waits for the ball to angle into him and cuts the ball down to third man for a single
Vinay Kumar gets the ball to bounce on Jayasuria who gets surprised and defends awkwardly on the off side
he angles a good length ball into the left-hander, Jayasuriya moves forward and closes the face to play the ball on the leg side
Tendulkar tries to force the ball through the leg side off the front foot, the length isn't short enough and he gets a thick inside edge on the leg side
good length delivery on off stump, Tendulkar strides forward and plays a punchy drive to cover
a half-volley on the pads, Tendulkar flicks towards deep square leg for a single
that's a terrible ball, a full toss off a short run-up down leg side, Goswami has no chance and the ball runs to the boundary
Praveen slants the ball wide across the right-hander from roudn the wicket, Bowden calls it wide
a bit short from Praveen and Tendulkar pulls the ball off the front foot over midwicket, he didn't time it well again but once again cleared the in-field
Tendulkar lofts through the line of a good length ball and although he doesn't time it well he manages to clear Kumble at mid-off, the ball runs down to the boundary
short of a length outside off, Tendulkar plays the ball off the front foot to point
Tendulkar moves forward and tries to swing the ball through leg, he misses and gets hit on the pad, that was missing leg stump
Jayasuriya moves forward to a good length ball which angles into him from round the wicket, he tries to hit down the ground once again but mis-hits it over cover, he manages to clear the infield
Steyn pitches around leg stump and Jayasuriya moves across to nudge the ball behind square, once again he gets hurried by Steyn's pace
that's a bit short and too far down leg side, Jayasuriya moves across his stumps and the ball goes through to Goswami
a bit too straight to the right-hander, Tendulkar jumps across his crease and flicks towards deep backward square leg
Steyn keeps Jayasuriya in his crease with his length and then cramps him for room by moving the ball into the left-hander, Jayasuriya tries to work the ball off his pads but misses
Jayasuriya defends off the back foot

Steyn angles a good length ball into the right hander and then seams it away from Tendulkar off the pitch, Tendulkar moves across and tries to flick but gets an outside edge that falls well short off first slip, Tendulkar was completely squared up
Tendulkar moves across his stumps and flicks a fuller ball off middle stump to square leg

and the change in strike as a result of that mis-field has cost Bangalore, Praveen bowls a full ball outside off stump, Jayasuriya lines him up and lofts off the front foot, he sends the ball sailing over the long-off boundary, he sends his team-mates scampering for cover in the dug out
Tendulkar moves forward and drives a full length ball towards Akhil at mid-on who mis-fields and allows the single, shoddy effort
shorter length outside off stump, Tendulkar takes a step forward and punches towards point, Mumbai have scored one off their last ten balls
he's in the action again! Tendulkar drives a full ball firmly towards cover where Boucher's in the way
Tendulkar strides forward and drives a good length ball on the up towards cover, Boucher dives to his right and makes a sharp save
good length delivery on off stump, defended off the front foot to the leg side
Steyn pitches the ball on a good length around off stump and seams the ball away from the left-hander, Jayasuriya tries to defend off the back foot but gets beaten by the pace and movement
short of a length and wide outside off stump, Jayasuriya slashes hard but gets beaten Goswami thinks he's nicked it, Goswami's keeping today not Boucher
Jayasuriya gets behind the line of a good length ball and defends on the off side
Jayasuriya tries to pull through square leg but once again gets hurried by Steyn's pace, he gets hit on the pad

that's a fantastic ball! Steyn pitches on a good length around off stump and cuts the ball back into Jayasuriya who gets cut in half as he tries to defend on the back foot, that ball was too quick for him
Steyn pitches short and fires the ball down leg side, Jayasuriya tries to pull but it's wide
a short of a length ball pitches around off stump and straightens into the left-hander, cramping Jayasuriya for room, he defends on the back foot
Tendulkar makes room by moving towards leg and pushes the ball back to Kumble
the line is on middle and leg and the length is short enough for Jayasuriya to swivel and pull to long leg
Tendulkar strides forward and pushes a flat delivery from middle and off in front of point, he hit that on the up
shorter length and a flatter trajectory, Jayasuriya nudges off his pads towards square leg
too full and Jayasuriya cashes in, he comes forward and lofts the ball back over the bowler's head for a one-bounce four
Jayasuriya leans forward and across to a full ball on middle stump and flicks to deep square leg
